caseName: Cannata v. City of New York
caseNameFull: CANNATA Et Al. v. CITY OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Raphael H. Weissman for appellants., Leo A. Larkin and Pauline K. Berger for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Goldberg took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
